|game_text=Deploy on a battleground. If you occupy, during battle here or at a related location, may place this Effect in Used Pile and choose: Draw up to two cards from Reserve Deck OR Prevent opponent from drawing any destinies during the power segment of that battle (except battle destiny).
|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E3 of [[Occupied Territory]] (version 4 of 4); it is the current text. The image here is the Master List slip ([[:File:VB7-04-Occupied_Territory-PC-E3-master-list.png]]). Each version below is quoted in full with its dated source; differences that come only from a document's medium (icons written out in words on the card list, straight quotes, credit lines) are not changes.
* '''Original''' ([[Occupied Territory]]): text as given in the Virtual Block 7.4 release sheet (official text as of 16 December 2011): “Deploy on a battleground. If you occupy, during battle here or at a related location, may place this Effect in Used Pile and choose: Draw up to two cards from Reserve Deck OR Prevent opponent from drawing any destinies during the power segment of that battle (except battle destiny).”.<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock7_4">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_4.pdf#page=2 Virtual Block 7.4 release sheet] ("Official text as of 16 December 2011"), page 2, slip 7 (position on the sheet; the slip prints no number). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022223114/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_4.pdf#page=2 Internet Archive]</ref> The release-sheet slip prints no slip number.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Occupied Territory (Errata)]]): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and still on 11 December 2012) changed “Prevent opponent from drawing any destinies” to “Prevent any destinies from being drawn” (no destinies may be drawn by either player): “Deploy on a battleground. If you occupy, during battle here or at a related location, may place this Effect in Used Pile and choose: Draw up to two cards from Reserve Deck OR Prevent any destinies from being drawn during the power segment of that battle (except battle destiny).”.<ref name="cl-1274_7-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock7Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064742/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2012-07-21] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211205229/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2012-12-11] (Internet Archive)</ref> The card list is a text page: no slip, picture or slip number, and icons are written out in words.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Occupied Territory (Errata 2)]]): The Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB7-D-occupiedterritory-pre.gif]]) prints the original printed text again, word for word: “Deploy on a battleground. If you occupy, during battle here or at a related location, may place this Effect in Used Pile and choose: Draw up to two cards from Reserve Deck OR Prevent opponent from drawing any destinies during the power segment of that battle (except battle destiny).” '''What changed:''' “Prevent opponent from drawing any destinies” again, for the card list's “Prevent any destinies from being drawn”. The image is undated. The PC's image folder (Virtual7-Dark) lists the file, with every other file in it, as last modified on 25 February 2013<ref name="r6-Virtual7-Dark">[https://web.archive.org/web/20190818034727/https://starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual7-Dark/large/?C=M;O=A Apache directory listing of Virtual7-Dark/large] (Internet Archive, captured 18 August 2019): every file in the folder last modified 25 February 2013; the captures of the image in 2018 and 2019 have the same bytes as the file on the wiki. Research note R6, 11 November 2026.</ref>; it is dated by that upload date, after the card list and before the Master List. The date is a bulk upload of the whole folder, so the image may have been made earlier, but the wiki orders versions by the date each document was published (Bill, 11 November 2026). It is a version of its own even though its words repeat an earlier text (Bill, 11 November 2026: every publication is a version). The card image is the whole card, with the Decipher picture; like the slip, it prints no slip number.
* '''PC-E3''' (this page): The Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013; Dark Side, p. 29)<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=29, page 29. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=29 Internet Archive]</ref> prints the original printed text again, word for word: “Deploy on a battleground. If you occupy, during battle here or at a related location, may place this Effect in Used Pile and choose: Draw up to two cards from Reserve Deck OR Prevent opponent from drawing any destinies during the power segment of that battle (except battle destiny).” '''What changed:''' Nothing in the words: the Master List prints the same words as the card image. The Master List repeats words published earlier; it is a version of its own because it was published after a different text (Bill, 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat). As the latest publication it is the current text. The PC website card list was generated from the Holotable card data; the Master List went back to the release-sheet words. The Master List slip shows the whole card frame with the picture area left blank; like the slip, it prints no slip number. GEMP's current card plays this text: only opponent is prevented from drawing power-segment destinies (play change from the card-list text, approved by Bill, 11 November 2026).
